ch4-001.does: Creates a numeric vector to loop over.

ch4-010.does: if statement: the block runs only when the condition is TRUE.
ch4-010.out: The addition message and 4 + 4, because operation equals "add".

ch4-020.does: Prints the results after the loop.
ch4-020.out: Odd numbers squared and even numbers doubled.
